description: A2A Protocol enhancement: Add structured communication modes (notify/consult/delegate), A2AMessage dataclass, A2ARouter with permission checks and CycleGuard integration, and response tracking with timeout for consult mode.
steps: 1. Create src/nexus/communication/a2a_router.py (new file, separate from existing a2a.py to avoid breaking changes): Define CommunicationMode enum (notify, consult, delegate). Define A2AMessage dataclass with: id, sender (UUID), recipient (UUID), mode (CommunicationMode), payload (dict), correlation_id (str), timeout_seconds (float|None), created_at, response (optional dict), response_received_at (optional datetime).

2. Create A2ARouter class in the same file: __init__(cycle_guard: CycleGuard | None = None, permissions: dict | None = None). Methods: send(message: A2AMessage) -> A2AMessage, check_permission(sender, recipient) -> bool, register_permission(sender, recipient, allowed_modes: list[CommunicationMode]). For 'delegate' mode, integrate with CycleGuard.check_delegation() to prevent infinite delegation loops.

3. Implement response tracking for consult mode: A2ARouter.respond(correlation_id, response_payload) to resolve a pending consult. A2ARouter.get_pending_consults(agent_id) to list unresolved consults. Track timeout expiration: A2ARouter.check_timeouts() marks expired consults as timed_out.
4. Update src/nexus/communication/__init__.py to export A2ARouter, A2AMessage, CommunicationMode.

5. Create tests/test_a2a_router.py with tests: notify mode fire-and-forget, consult mode with response tracking, consult mode timeout, delegate mode with CycleGuard integration (verify CycleGuardError raised on loops), permission checks (allowed/denied), multiple messages with correlation tracking.
acceptance_criteria: A2AMessage dataclass exists with sender, recipient, mode, payload, correlation_id, timeout fields
CommunicationMode enum has notify, consult, delegate values
A2ARouter routes messages with permission checks
Delegate mode integrates with CycleGuard and raises CycleGuardError on loops
Consult mode tracks responses and handles timeouts
Existing communication tests still pass (python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_communication.py -q)
New tests in tests/test_a2a_router.py all pass
